item.title: Megan Thee Stallion’s $550 grant helped teen launch mental health nonprofit; project has delivered 3,300 boxes
item.description: In January 2024, 12-year-old Mila Henry founded MH Boxes, aiming to support Black girls facing mental health challenges. With a $550 grant from the #BlackGirlJoyChallenge, she crafted care packages containing essential self-care items. To date, the initiative has successfully distributed over 3,300 boxes nationwide, striving to break the stigma surrounding mental health in the Black community.
item.dc:creator: TOI World Desk

item.title: 'Trump will take his dream to his grave': Iran says won't allow US warships in Hormuz
item.description: Iran has expressed its determination to prevent US military presence in the Persian Gulf amid escalating tensions. US Ambassador to Turkiye Tom Barrack mentioned the potential for a US strike on Iran this weekend. Despite threats, Barrack stated that President Trump continues to seek a diplomatic agreement. Trump emphasised that further military action remains a possibility if negotiations do not progress.
item.dc:creator: Pranjal Pandey

item.title: Josh Hutcherson’s former Hollywood Hills home sold for $2.94 M
item.description: Josh Hutcherson's Midcentury Modern home in Hollywood Hills has changed hands several times among famous owners. Ellen DeGeneres initially bought the house, followed by Heath Ledger and later Hutcherson. The property features original elements like beamed ceilings and modern appliances in the kitchen. A spacious outdoor deck enhances its appeal by providing a serene environment. Hutcherson sold the home for $2.94 million, equal to his purchase price eight years earlier.
item.dc:creator: TOI Real Estate Desk

item.title: Artist Mark Cline built a foam Stonehenge replica in 2004; it later moved to a Virginia farm
item.description: In 2004, Mark Cline constructed Foamhenge, a whimsical replica of Stonehenge, to entice tourists. After more than a decade in Natural Bridge, Virginia, it needed to relocate in 2016 due to park land developments. Foamhenge found a new home at Cox Farms, debuting during the 2017 Fall Festival, where visitors can enjoy specific viewing hours throughout the event.

item.title: Selena Gomez’s charity benefit raises $2.7 M for mental health
item.description: Selena Gomez proudly hosted the fourth annual Rare Impact Fund Benefit in Los Angeles, successfully raising significant funds for mental health initiatives. The evening took an exciting turn when her husband, Benny Blanco, bid an impressive $25,000 for a special modeling experience with Gomez’s glam team. During the event, she reaffirmed her dedication to youth mental health and introduced the Katherine Short Legacy Award, with a remarkable total of $2.
item.dc:creator: TOI World Desk

item.title: New York couple's 30-year property dispute takes a turn after cameras record minor daughter
item.description: A couple in New York found themselves entangled in a complex property disagreement with their neighbors regarding a disputed land boundary tied to a chain-link fence. This conflict escalated, resulting in claims of trespassing and invasion of privacy due to surveillance cameras. Although the court struggled to rule on the boundary dispute, it has permitted the couple's privacy claims to advance for further scrutiny.
item.dc:creator: TOI World Desk

item.title: Nebraska workers sink 150 trees in two lakes to create underwater shelter for young fish
item.description: In Nebraska, conservationists launched an innovative project by strategically removing overgrown trees and submerging them to foster underwater fish habitats. With 150 trees now placed in two lakes, this initiative not only improves access for fishermen but also revitalizes the aquatic ecosystem. By addressing dense shorelines, the project aims to enhance the fishing experience while simultaneously supporting thriving fish populations.
item.dc:creator: TOI World Desk

item.title: George Michael’s Last Christmas royalties help fund 20-plus grants for vulnerable young people
item.description: Royalties from Wham!'s beloved holiday song Last Christmas have led to substantial charitable funding through the George Michael Fund. Founded to pay tribute to George Michael, this initiative focuses on assisting children and young people in the UK who confront various life challenges. As the song approaches its 40th year, its societal impact in promoting mental health and combating homelessness remains significant, showcasing Michael's enduring commitment to those in need.
item.dc:creator: TOI World Desk

item.title: ‘Largest ever’: Elon Musk donates $443m to Trump's campaign ahead of US midterms
item.description: Billionaire Elon Musk has contributed more than $442 million to Republican campaigns as the midterm elections approach. Recent filings show Musk made sizable donations through his America PAC and his company. The PAC has focused spending on competitive Senate races, particularly opposing Democratic candidates in key states. Significant amounts of the funding have directed towards the Texas Senate race and others like Ohio and Michigan.

item.title: Little-known Dutch painting from English manor collection sells for £70,000 against £8,000 estimate
item.description: A charming oil painting, thought to be created by Hendrik Gerritsz Pot, surfaced during an October auction after being held within a family collection for years. This artwork, illustrating a woman with a lute accompanied by a dog, has a dubious connection to Pot's Merry Company series. It astonishingly sold for £70,000, outpacing its initial estimate of £8,000, reflecting heightened bidder enthusiasm.
item.dc:creator: TOI World Desk

item.title: Watch: Paris shops increase security, board up windows, as France braces for protests
item.description: Shopkeepers in Paris are taking measures to secure their businesses against possible renewed protests and violence. Authorities are increasing police presence, with around 70,000 officers deployed this weekend across France. Demonstrations are planned in several cities, amidst ongoing political tensions leading to protests against rising living costs. While some support the protests, others condemn the associated looting and vandalism.

item.title: 'Another little Epic Fury': Trump issues new warning; Iran says 'don't play with fire'
item.description: US President Donald Trump threatened Iran with potential military action if no diplomatic agreement is reached soon. He referenced the previous operation named 'Epic Fury' while addressing supporters in Florida. Additionally, US intelligence reports indicate Iran's increased efforts to target American diplomats in the Middle East. Amidst rising tensions, the US has ordered non-emergency personnel to leave Saudi Arabia due to security concerns.
